extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism scope; no direct molecular target is promoted beyond phenotype-supported antifungal, anti-adhesion, hyphal-invasion, biofilm/catheter, toxicity, and stability evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The alpha7 helix and shorter alpha7-derived peptides retain protective antifungal activity in C. elegans infection assays, with 12aa retaining strong activity and 9aa losing protection.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: EntV alpha7 fragments, especially 16aa alpha7 and 12aa

source_locator.locator: Results: The alpha7 helix is sufficient for antifungal activity; Shorter peptides retain activity; Fig. 2/Fig. 3 captions and Supplementary Data 1

mechanism_claims.limitations: Protective phenotype does not identify a direct molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: EntV/alpha7/12aa reduce Candida albicans adhesion and mouse OPC hyphal invasion/fungal burden in source-data panels.

source_locator.locator: Results: alpha7 sufficient; 12mer protective in OPC; Fig. 2b/d, Fig. 3b/d, Fig. 5 and supplementary source data

mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology/adhesion phenotypes are not promoted to direct molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: EntV and 12aa protect in rat venous catheter and systemic mouse Candida albicans infection models without evidence of direct Candida killing in the systemic pre-incubation check.

source_locator.locator: Results: The 12mer is protective in a rat venous catheter model; The 12mer is protective in a systemic mouse model; Fig. 6 caption

mechanism_claims.limitations: Protective effect is source-supported, but direct target and killing mechanism remain unresolved.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Human RBC hemolysis source data show no significant hemolysis for EntV/12aa under tested conditions, while serum stability is limited over 24 h.

source_locator.locator: Supplemental Fgiure 6 rows: fractional hemolysis and serum stability; Methods hemolysis and serum stability assays

mechanism_claims.limitations: Toxicity and serum-stability observations constrain translational interpretation but are not antifungal target mechanisms.
